title: Spyglass is Here: Experience Enhanced Insights
summary: The highly anticipated Spyglass tool has officially launched, bringing powerful new capabilities to help you gain deeper insights and streamline your work.

title: Enhanced File Control and Display
summary: We've launched powerful new tools, empowering you to seamlessly upload, manage, and customize how your images and documents appear directly within the editor.

title: Track Our Progress with the New Public Roadmap
summary: Stay informed with our new public roadmap, detailing our completed features, upcoming releases, and exciting future plans.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a smoother workflow with our redesigned checkboxes, now bigger, easier to drag, and beautifully integrated into your editor.

title: Smarter Collaboration for Effortless Teamwork
summary: Our improved collaboration tools now offer a more intuitive and seamless experience, ensuring your team stays perfectly in sync and works together effortlessly.

title: Enhanced Shared Item Discovery
summary: Effortlessly discover and access all shared content, ensuring you never miss an important collaboration with your network.

title: Global Language Support
summary: This exciting new feature makes Noeko fully accessible and optimized for users in their preferred languages, no matter where they are in the world.

title: Noeko Embraces Open Source!
summary: We're thrilled to open-source Noeko's codebase, empowering our community with unprecedented control and direct involvement in shaping its future.

title: Dynamic Graph View Filters
summary: Uncover deeper insights and navigate your knowledge network with ease, thanks to new filtering options by tags and time, alongside enhanced visibility for shared content and connections.

title: Advanced Search & Custom Collections
summary: Efficiently pinpoint and organize your content with powerful new search filters, dynamic sorting options, and the ability to save your refined results as personalized collections for instant access.

title: Dynamic Note Display Options
summary: Discover powerful new display options for your linked content, transforming how you structure and interact with your notes for a more intuitive and personalized workspace.

title: Unleash Noeko: Self-Hosting & Advanced Plans
summary: Experience ultimate control by hosting Noeko on your own infrastructure and unlock powerful features with our upcoming advanced plans.

title: Enhanced Themes and New Style Options
summary: Get ready for a stunning visual upgrade as we enhance our existing themes and introduce a vibrant collection of brand-new styles for unparalleled personalization.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: We're updating our greetings to perfectly match the time of day, ensuring a delightful and accurate welcome every time you visit.

title: Enhanced Tag Management
summary: Quickly remove items from tags or delete content directly from your tag lists, saving you time and streamlining your workflow.

title: Unlock More Content Types
summary: Gain a comprehensive understanding of your information by seamlessly integrating diverse content types, including videos, web pages, and plain text, directly into your workflow.
